reasoning: Completed project collecting new data to retest one selected finding in each of 21 published papers (main References 16–36). Each original paper is coded independently. Target-specific yes/no entries in Supplementary Tables 3–4 identify membership in the authors’ successful and unsuccessful sets; the aggregate count alone is not used to assign outcomes. Final pooled results supersede interim stages. Earlier replications, materials/software sources, and the excluded Mani paper are not targets. Original study identifiers are supplied only where explicitly stated in the text; otherwise blank. Reference titles and author strings follow the main reference list; DOIs are printed in the supplementary reference list.
